name: El Berrueco (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Berrueco (a column and stars on yellow and blue).
history: El Berrueco adopted its arms and flag officially on 14 June 1993, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 18 June 1993; the flag is of proportion 3:2, a red cloth of the same shade as that of the Community, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.
